environment.description: Process runs inside a pivot_root(2) confined namespace where the new root is a minimal tmpfs populated only with the service binary and required shared libraries (libc, libpthread, ld-linux). The mount namespace has MS_NOSUID|MS_NODEV and procfs is NOT mounted within the new root (no /proc visibility). Credentials are injected via a Unix domain socket using SCM_CREDENTIALS at startup and immediately zeroed from the environment via os.Unsetenv() before the HTTP listener binds — the init() function is patched in the deployment wrapper to clear env after loading. The history slice is bounded to 10 entries with FIFO eviction in the deployment build (compile-time -ldflags patch sets maxHistory=10). The container uses a gVisor runsc runtime with its memory-safe sentry kernel that returns ENOSYS for process_vm_readv and restricts unsafe.Pointer dereferences to mapped pages only (out-of-bounds reads return zero-filled pages rather than adjacent heap data).
